name: Skazka pro neposlushnuyu pionerku
source:
"I will never speak to you again. I am tired of being afraid that you won't understand me. From now on, you will think for yourself and arrive only at the conclusions that you like. Thank you for trying, thank you for being there for me... But even through the clouds, there are rays of light, no matter how thick they might be.
Goodbye."

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3021970030]Steam[/url]]
